After the success of Episode I – The Phantom Menace, George Lucas released the Special Editions of the original Star Wars trilogy, which included several controversial changes, such as adding a CG Jabba the Hutt in A New Hope. Most notoriously, a scene in the Mos Eisley cantina was re-edited to show that Greedo shot at Han Solo first, which changed the dynamic of their encounter.

The original Planet of the Apes ends with a shocking twist: a shot of the ruined Statue of Liberty reveals that what we believed to be an alien world is, in fact, Earth. Tim Burton's 2001 remake does not replicate this twist; instead, it presents a different narrative in which Mark Wahlberg's character discovers a version of Earth that has been dominated by apes, but the ending does not feature the Statue of Liberty as an ape.
